completed_gate.source: U.S. DOE/NNSA DOE/NV--209-REV 16, U.S. Nuclear Tests - By Date
completed_gate.selection_rule: U.S. entries in study window whose DOE physical type is Airdrop, Airburst, Balloon, Barge, Surface, Tower or Rocket; exclude Crater, Underwater, Shaft and Tunnel.
completed_gate.reason_for_nonexact_label: The paper states the DOE/NV-209 Rev.16 selection rule but the authors' own date file has not been acquired. TOPA therefore calls this a literal reconstruction, not a byte-identical author manifest.

ambiguity_frozen_before_outcome.issue: DOE includes Surface safety experiments (Project 56 and Project 57 No.1) inside the period; the phrase 'nuclear weapons tests' could be parsed with or without these rows.
ambiguity_frozen_before_outcome.primary_arm: DOE_LITERAL_US_ABOVEGROUND includes them because physical type is Surface and DOE lists them as tests.
ambiguity_frozen_before_outcome.guard: Both arms are declared now. Neither may be selected after inspecting the closed/open effect.

still_blocked.original_vasco_ml_repository: Paper-named https://github.com/dca-doherty/VASCO-ML currently returns 404 in this audit pass.

Run TOPA_POSS1_CLOSED_OPEN_HARMONIZATION_01 with the frozen DOE literal primary arm and the predeclared safety-experiment sensitivity arm.
Only after that decide whether the external ML architecture deserves canonical absorption into TOPA.
no_shortcuts: No synthetic replacement for 107875 real rows.
